title: Inclusion of History and Maintenance of Tripartite Relations in School Curriculum
what_it_is: Inclusion of History and Maintenance of Tripartite Relations in School Curriculum

sections.label: Tripartism taught in schools
sections.summary: Tripartism contributed to Singapore's growth, and students learn aspects of it in Social Studies, History and Economics.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Acting Ministers for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Acting Minister for Education (Schools))
sentences.text: Our model of tripartism – the social partnership between Government, employers and workers – has contributed greatly to our economic growth and success.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Acting Ministers for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Acting Minister for Education (Schools))
sentences.text: So, it is important for our students to know and understand how tripartism shaped Singapore and how it continues to have a role to play today and in the future.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Acting Ministers for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Acting Minister for Education (Schools))
sentences.text: While tripartism is not specifically taught as a topic on its own, students do learn about aspects of tripartism in Social Studies, History and Economics.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Acting Ministers for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Acting Minister for Education (Schools))
sentences.text: For example, through the History subject, our Secondary students learn how the Singapore Labour Movement activity in the 1950s reflected people's grievances and created the need for mediation and the crucial need to maintain peaceful relations between workers and employers.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Acting Ministers for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Acting Minister for Education (Schools))
sentences.text: In the case of Singapore, our students will then gain a deeper understanding of how tripartism created a conducive environment that attracted foreign investment to Singapore and created good jobs for Singaporeans.

sections.label: MOE to study suggestion
sections.summary: MOE is asked to look at the Member's suggestion and study it deeply.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: Let MOE look at the suggestion that the Member has made and let us study it deeply.

sections.label: Revised Social Studies syllabus
sections.summary: The Social Studies syllabus was recently revised, and tripartism aspects in the subjects are tailored to suit age.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: The Member will take note that we have recently revised our Social Studies syllabus.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: Of course, we do revise our syllabus along the way and evolve with the developments.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: So, the various aspects of tripartism explored in the various subjects that I have mentioned – History, Social Studies or Economics – are tailored to suit the age.
